## 📚 Practical exercise

Select your own way to practice:

- *R way:* Reproduce [Nighttime Cooling Patterns](https://github.com/savcooley/2026_thermalRS_urban_heat_demo)

- *Python way:* Reproduce [Exploring ECOSTRESS L2T LSTE](https://nasa.github.io/VITALS/python/Exploring_ECOSTRESS_L2T_LSTE.html)

- *Customized way:* Reproduce [any of these tutorials](https://github.com/ECOSTRESS-Tutorials)
